title: Remove review verdict trees on every exit path
body:
Outcome: krn review removes its .krn/tmp/verdict-* red-first trees on every exit path (success, failure, signal); a test proves no verdict dir survives an interrupted run.
Evidence: .krn/runs/delivery-loop/session-continuity/predecessor-retire/ (PR #159). On 2026-11-01 /mnt/storage hit 100% (2.4 GB free): .krn/worktrees/context-budget/.krn/tmp held 8+ verdict-* dirs of ~1.9 GB each from 10-29 (16.6 GB), no process referenced them.
